QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_56

question.text: Which of the following issuers are accepted for an identity card/document with address used as proof of address for KYC?

answer.text: Central/State Government, statutory/regulatory authorities, PSUs, scheduled commercial banks, public financial institutions, colleges affiliated to universities (for students), and professional bodies such as ICAI, ICWAI, ICSI and Bar Council
Only documents from the police department

explanation.text: The Logic: Identity cards/documents with address issued by Central/State Government, statutory/regulatory authorities, PSUs, scheduled commercial banks, public financial institutions, colleges affiliated to universities (valid while student), and professional bodies (ICAI, ICWAI, ICSI, Bar Council) are accepted as proof of address. The Trap: 'Only government-issued' is too narrow; statutory/regulatory authorities, PSUs, scheduled commercial banks, public FIs, colleges and professional bodies are also authorized issuers. Note: A college/university-issued identity document is valid as POA only while the applicant is a student. Bank-issued credit/debit cards are listed as proof of identity, not as proof of address.
